behaviors.behavior: A configured fan-out whose first peer arrives after the old 0.1s probe window is still awaited (the pinned root cause)
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_ensure_shared_cache_fanout_timing.py::test_a_fanout_arriving_after_the_probe_window_is_still_awaited — red against pre-fix code by construction

behaviors.behavior: All expected peers already observed returns immediately, without consuming the arrival grace
A configured fan-out where no peer ever arrives returns at _FANOUT_ARRIVAL_GRACE_SECONDS, not at the hard ceiling
The un-enumerable path (peers is None, or fewer than 2) still returns after the unchanged bounded settle sleep, never entering the wait loop
The hard ceiling is anchored at entry and cannot be reset by a late arrival, and returns EXACTLY at the bound rather than one poll interval past it
behaviors.evidence: test_ensure_shared_cache_fanout_timing.py::test_continuous_arrivals_cannot_push_the_ceiling_past_entry_plus_wait — mutation-verified: flat poll yields 3.00999s against an exact-3.0 assertion

behaviors.behavior: The ceiling stays below both neighbouring budgets, asserted against the imported constants rather than literals
An observation by an identity outside the expected peer set is not progress and does not extend the idle deadline
A repeated observation by an already-counted EXPECTED peer is not progress
behaviors.evidence: test_ensure_shared_cache_fanout_timing.py::test_a_repeated_observation_by_an_expected_peer_is_not_progress — mutation-verified: broken duplicate handling rides to 3.01s, correct returns at 1.3s

behaviors.behavior: A transient unreadable marker does not abandon the barrier; it is re-read on the next pass and the ceiling bounds a permanently unreadable one
Completion membership is rebuilt each pass, so a marker that stops validating mid-wait stops counting toward completion
behaviors.evidence: test_ensure_shared_cache_fanout_markers.py::test_an_observation_that_stops_validating_stops_counting — mutation-verified: accumulated 0.8s, count-based 1.4s, correct 1.8s (discriminates three implementations)

behaviors.evidence: integration-tests/test_ensure_shared_cache_fanout.py::test_healthy_cache_fanout_elects_one_scanner_and_copies_nothing — 4/6 FAILING pre-fix, 10/10 under 22-core saturation post-fix (re-measured against the final implementation)

behaviors.behavior: All 13 copies of the changed hook stay byte-identical, and every hook-bearing plugin still registers it
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_ensure_shared_cache_vendored.py (bidirectional drift guard) — verified 1 distinct sha256 across all 13

behaviors.behavior: A hung cache writer still causes the firing process to skip repair without mutating the cache (fixture precondition repaired for the new timing budget)
